summary: Describes an architecture and framework for letting applications talk to middleboxes such as firewalls and address translators. Such devices cannot always handle protocols like SIP or H.323 by looking at packet headers alone, so the framework lets trusted agents help them make decisions.

eli5.summary: Imagine a guard at a gate who cannot tell which visitors are expected. This document describes a way for a helper to tell the guard who is allowed in, so the right visitors get through.

questions: how can applications talk to firewalls
